scope: Actual44 Next production workspace and real isolated SQLite Nest API inherited exactly from43, generated users/files only; one real committed response was deliberately dropped. No production runtime, physical camera, teacher or learner-effect acceptance.

checks.name: Actual workspace unified add picker opens image capture; opening and empty file selection create no upload, page, group, task or learning fact
Actual product IndexedDB restores two exact original files and title after full page reload without automatically uploading or recognizing
Real original uploads preserve duplicate bytes as separate page IDs; dropping an actual committed complete response is recovered through its original command without a second page
Actual pixel crop and clockwise rotation publish a new page version; explicit group revisions preserve exact selected order and prior history
Explicit recognize creates a real durable derivation; actual worker saves the frozen PDF and original material, and the workspace returns to that material reader
Persistent workspace exit guard blocks an exact capture change with unsaved input and keeps keyboard focus inside the existing confirmation dialog
Actual existing workspace capture dialog rendered without horizontal content overflow at 320, 768, 1024 and 1440 pixels
Blocked replaceState keeps the exact live input; an actual downloaded complete copy must be selected and read back before continuation, which opens the independent new slot
Actual native Back is blocked with unsaved new-slot input and resumes after a complete IndexedDB write/readback while the guard remains registered

Actual damaged-original report opens the existing-style repair dialog; a wrong candidate is retained without uploading, and its complete binary copy must be downloaded and read back before closing and can be imported without replay

Explicit exact-file staging creates no repair until confirmation; an actually committed repair response is deliberately lost, recovered by its original command, and a real durable worker restores the same original bytes and receipt without another repair

Actual private incomplete-upload control explicitly contains no original bytes, retains the full cancellation, and recovers an actually lost committed cancel response by the original upload ID without fabricating a receipt

Missing-original control rejects a different real file, then validates the exact SHA, size and MIME and transfers it into an independent complete image draft; explicit resume saves the original upload and page identities
A completed upload remains discoverable for original receipt recovery and reopening its independent complete draft after a lost completion; no duplicate page is created

Actual product rebuilds and selects a processed-page candidate from the real original, retains source provenance in its complete draft and creates a durable source_rebuild repair only after explicit staging and confirmation
Actual product reads the same derivation other intact PDF as an exact candidate, preserves its original source proof and restores only the original material-PDF bytes through a real worker
